exposure: high fetal weight during third trimester
outcome: large for gestational age at delivery
cohort: 176 pregnant women with normal glycemic index at 24-28 gestational weeks and ultrasonography (US) suggested high fetal weight during the third trimester
finding: Pregnant women diagnosed with late gestational diabetes (LGDM) had comparable obstetric and neonatal complications to those without LGDM, except for a significantly higher cesarean section rate.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was significantly higher in the late gestational diabetes (GDM) group compared to the non-GDM group (76.19% versus 51.52%; p<0.05).
